sanskrit_verse: सत्येन शापयेद्विप्रं क्षत्रियं वाहनायुधैः। गोबीजकाञ्चनैर्वैश्यं शूद्रं सर्वैस्तु पातकैः॥
transliteration: satyena śāpayed vipraṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ | gobījakāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvaiḥ tu pātakaiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: By truth alone is a Brahmin to be sanctioned; by conveyance and weaponry, a Kshatriya; by livestock and gold, a Vaishya; and by all forms of misdeeds, a Shudra.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Satya (Truth)
Restoration logic operates via proportional consequence mechanisms
Consciousness alignment determines the mode of corrective engagement
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor = Brahmin THEN enforceability condition = truth-verifiability
IF actor = Kshatriya THEN enforceability condition = control over mobility and defense instruments
IF actor = Vaishya THEN enforceability condition = economic-value equivalency
IF actor = Shudra THEN enforceability condition = comprehensive causal impact mapping
ALL sanctions MUST map to consciousness-restoring thresholds without punitive encoding
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that enforcement must align with the actor's constitutional capacity within dharma-vācaka order. The threshold for responsibility varies per varna-determined capability domain. Truth binds Brahmins absolutely, while broader causal patterns govern others. Enforcement remains valid only when it realigns consciousness rather than imposes suffering.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality here assigns consequences aligned precisely with the instrumentality of action. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfolding of capacity-based accountability. Proportionality emerges naturally from dharmic role-positioning. Non-punitive reality rule ensures no suffering-induction occurs—only completion-processes are activated.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate satya-pratijña completion for Brahmin actors
Implement go-bīja-kāñcana parity restoration for Vaishyas
Activate sarva-pātaka causal-integrity review for Shudras
Reintegrate individual svadharma capacity through consciousness-first protocols
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority. Dharma is restored through precise alignment of consciousness and capacity. Justice flows not through punishment but through reintegration into Truth. Reality acknowledges only non-punitive law. Consciousness stands as the ultimate Adjudicator.
